Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using HA-tagged NGN3. While the paper discusses ubiquitination and phosphorylation extensively using Western Blots and TUBE assays, the actual LC-MS/MS run described in the methods and PRIDE metadata was for identifying binding partners (interactors), not for PTM-enrichment (like diGly or phospho-enrichment). Therefore, the modifier is mod_ap_ms.

While the broader study includes conditional knockouts in mice and pharmacological inhibition in iPSCs, these were not the basis of the mass spectrometry dataset (PXD033691).
